screens.title: 1 · Lista: the delivery leads
screens.why: The delivery is the title and its next task the one line under it; Agora, Ainda hoje, and the list stops at the day.

pins.label: Delivery as title
pins.text: Consecutive tasks of one delivery are one card: its name in bodyStrong with the stack icon, the whole run's hours on the right. No more AppTag per task.

pins.label: Only the next task
pins.text: Lista shows one line under the name: the next task (accent dot while it runs, ring while it waits), without an hour. The hours on the right say how long the run is.

pins.label: One bar, in pieces
pins.text: Agora ends in one bar made of one piece per task of the run, as long as its minutes: done full, running as far as it got, the rest empty. Controls act on the running task.

pins.label: Ainda hoje
pins.text: Fazer em breve becomes Ainda hoje: only today's hours. Same words as the calendar's headings.

pins.label: Loose tasks stay
pins.text: A task with no delivery keeps its own card, as today.

screens.title: 2 · Lista after the day: Amanhã
screens.why: Once the working day is over, the list shows tomorrow; everything further is one line away.

pins.label: Agora, day over
pins.text: Agora is always the first stage; outside the working day it is DayOverTile, as on the calendar.

pins.label: Amanhã
pins.text: With the day over (or nothing left in it), the stage is Amanhã: tomorrow's hours only, each delivery with its next task.

pins.label: The list stops
pins.text: Tasks queued past that day are not drawn: 'Mais 5 tarefas adiante' and 'Ver no calendário', which switches mode.

pins.label: Para depois
pins.text: Depois eu priorizo is renamed Para depois. Backlog tasks of one delivery group too, headed with '2 tarefas · 2h30'.

screens.title: 3 · Calendário: same card, to scale
screens.why: Agora stays on top; on the calendar a delivery's run is one block as tall as its time, with every task as a line where they fit.

pins.label: Agora as a timeline
pins.text: The same Agora card as Lista, but every task of the run is a line with its hour: done struck through, running in ink, the next waiting.

pins.label: Run as one block
pins.text: Escrever, Gravar, Editar: one block 13:00–15:00. Each line sits at its hour when the block has room for all of them.

pins.label: Unchanged
pins.text: Free stretches, routines and fixed blocks are drawn as today.

screens.title: 4 · Calendário: what fits
screens.why: Lines at their hours when they fit, the next task alone when not, and a lone task with its notes.

pins.label: Café da manhã
pins.text: A routine with items is the same card in the routine's fill, with the repeat mark. Needs a routine checklist in the model: second phase.

pins.label: Lines at their hours
pins.text: Each line sits where its hour falls in the block, never closer than a line's height to the next.

pins.label: One task: its notes
pins.text: A run of one task has no list to draw, so the card shows the task and the start of its notes, as the calendar always did (notesPreview, up to 3 lines).

pins.label: Too short: the next
pins.text: Three 15-minute tasks don't fit as lines in 55 minutes, so the block falls back to Lista's look: the name and the next task.

screens.title: 5 · Entregas by when they end
screens.why: No goals and no Fila heading; deliveries headed by due day like the timeline's days, each with one bar: green work over red time.

pins.label: Metas hidden
pins.text: ArtifactsPage(showGoals: false) by default: the goal cards and Nova meta are not drawn. Routes, model and agent verbs untouched.

pins.label: Due headings
pins.text: No 'Fila' heading: the due days are the page's only headings, set as the timeline sets Agora, Ainda hoje and its days (title, ink). Hoje (today or late), Amanhã, Nos próximos 7 dias, Mais adiante, Sem prazo, sorted by deadline; the queue's order breaks ties. The drag to reorder goes away.

pins.label: One bar, two fills
pins.text: Red (paceTime) is the share of the time gone; green (paceDone), drawn over it, the share of tasks done. Green covering red is ahead; red showing past the green is lagging, by as much as shows.

pins.label: The key
pins.text: A dot of each colour: what green counts (3 de 5 etapas) and what red runs to (termina hoje), in danger ink once late.

pins.label: In words
pins.text: 'no ritmo' or 'atrás do ritmo' (warning) still closes the subtitle, so colour is not the only signal.

pins.label: The example
pins.text: Júlia: 5 of 10 tasks done, a little over half her time gone. Only a hair of red shows: on pace.
